name: Althos
text: Althos was one of the sons of Usnoth in the Ossianic poetry of James Macpherson from the year 1760. Macpherson gave Usnoth a set of sons and placed them in his invented heroic past. Althos appears only in this verse cycle.

attributes.attribute: one of the sons of Usnoth in the Ossianic cycles

key_results: Name Althos among the sons of Usnoth.
